training_data: Wang, Q., Mei, Z., Zhan, F., & Chen, J. (2026). Acoustic data for the manuscript entitled 'Self-supervised acoustic leakage detection for water distribution systems: A real-time diagnosis framework under data scarcity' (v1). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18631450
training_data_licence: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode), as stated in the saved Zenodo record metadata. AquaRadar extracted audio features and trained a classifier; this is not endorsed by the dataset authors. See docs/dataset_documentation.md.
evaluation: 5-fold grouped CV (coarse groups), pooled out-of-fold balanced accuracy 0.787
limitations: Single-site dataset; not validated on campus pipes.
Screening result only: resembles labelled training clips; not proof of a leak.
Noise class covers only the 15 sound categories in the dataset.
Expects 1.0 s clips; longer recordings need windowing (not implemented yet).
